title: I intend on keeping the subscription because its a good value, but the kids interest (ages 5 and ...
text:
I intend on keeping the subscription because its a good value, but the kids interest (ages 5 and 7) have been pretty limited in the 4 toys we have received so far.

...which is not surprising, as I have some peripheral experience in educational STEM game development and know that it is a vast landscape of products with great intentions and potential, but that toys and games which have lasting standalone engagement are extremely few and far between even in the non-educational space, so this field is even harder to succeed.

Especially when kids are more than ever eschewing real-world toys for digital, trying to capture their interest and attention with physical toys is tough.
label: positive
